Requirement: The system shall allow users to log in with email and password.
The application must support user registration with email verification.
The system shall provide a dashboard for viewing all active projects.
Users shall be able to create and manage tasks within a project.
The system must allow file uploads up to 50 MB.
The application shall send email notifications for important events.
Users must be able to search and filter records by date and category.
The system shall generate PDF reports for completed projects.
The application must support import and export of data in CSV format.
The system shall maintain a history of all changes made to records.
Users shall be able to assign roles to team members.
The system must allow bulk operations on selected records.
The application shall support multi-language interface.
The system shall provide an API for third-party integrations.
Users must be able to schedule automated reports.
The system shall provide role-based access control for all modules.
The application must validate all user inputs before processing.
Users shall be able to reset their password via email.
The system must log all user activities for audit purposes.
The application shall support single sign-on with OAuth2 providers.
The system shall allow administrators to manage user accounts.
The application must provide two-factor authentication.
Users shall be able to view and edit their profile information.
The system must enforce session timeout after 30 minutes of inactivity.
The application shall allow users to export their data.
The system shall respond to user requests within 2 seconds under normal load.
The application must be available 99.9 percent of the time.
The database shall support up to 1 million records without performance degradation.
The system must handle 1000 concurrent users without response time exceeding 5 seconds.
The application shall complete search queries in under 500 milliseconds.
All user passwords must be stored using bcrypt hashing.
The system shall encrypt all data in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.
All API endpoints must require authentication using JWT tokens.
The application shall protect against SQL injection attacks.
The system must implement CSRF protection for all forms.
User sessions shall expire after a period of inactivity.
The application must sanitize all inputs to prevent XSS attacks.
The system shall implement rate limiting to prevent brute force attacks.
All sensitive data must be encrypted at rest.
The application shall maintain a security audit log.
The system shall be available 24 hours a day 7 days a week.
The application must recover from failures within 30 seconds.
The system shall provide failover capability for critical components.
Planned downtime must not exceed 4 hours per month.
The application must support graceful degradation when components fail.
The system shall load any page within 3 seconds on a standard connection.
Database queries must complete within 100 milliseconds for 95 percent of requests.
The application shall support horizontal scaling to handle increased load.
The system must process uploaded files within 60 seconds.
The application shall cache frequently accessed data to improve response time.
The system must optimize images during upload to reduce storage and bandwidth.
The application shall follow the company brand guidelines for colors and fonts.
The user interface must be intuitive and require minimal training.
The system shall use consistent icons and terminology throughout.
The application must support dark mode and light mode themes.
The user interface shall be accessible to users with disabilities following WCAG 2.1.
The system shall provide a step-by-step wizard for complex tasks.
The application must display helpful error messages with resolution guidance.
The user interface shall support keyboard navigation for all features.
The system must allow users to undo the last 10 actions.
The application shall remember user preferences across sessions.
The system shall support horizontal scaling by adding more server instances.
The application must support database sharding for large datasets.
The architecture shall allow new modules to be added without system downtime.
The system must scale to support 10 times the current user base.
The application shall use microservices architecture to allow independent scaling.
The system shall provide monitoring dashboards for operations team.
The application must support automated backups every 24 hours.
System administrators shall be able to deploy updates without service interruption.
The system must generate alerts when resource utilization exceeds 80 percent.
The application shall support configuration changes without restart.
The codebase shall follow SOLID design principles.
All modules must have unit test coverage of at least 80 percent.
The application shall use centralized logging for easy debugging.
The system must have comprehensive API documentation.
Code reviews are required before merging any changes to the main branch.
The application must comply with GDPR data protection requirements.
The system shall obtain user consent before collecting personal data.
The application must provide users with the ability to request data deletion.
The system shall maintain data processing records as required by law.
The application must include a privacy policy that explains data usage.
The application shall be deployable on Windows Linux and macOS.
The system must support Chrome Firefox Safari and Edge browsers.
The application shall provide native mobile apps for iOS and Android.
The system must support cloud deployment on AWS Azure and GCP.
The system shall automatically retry failed operations up to 3 times.
The application must maintain a circuit breaker for external service calls.
Critical data shall be replicated across multiple geographic regions.
The system must continue operating in read-only mode during database maintenance.
The application shall queue failed operations and process them when service is restored.
The system should be able to process at least 500 transactions per second.
The application shall require strong passwords with at least 12 characters.
The user shall be able to add comments to any task or project item.
The system must support real-time collaboration for multiple users.
The application shall allow managers to generate team performance reports.
Users must be able to configure notification preferences.
The system shall maintain 99.95 percent uptime during business hours.
The system must support auto-scaling based on traffic patterns.
The application shall use dependency injection for loose coupling.
The system must perform vulnerability scanning on every deployment.
The application shall support active-active clustering for zero downtime deployments.
The dashboard must display key metrics in a visually appealing chart format.
